fusions.name: Edge-First Bash
fusions.desc: Bashes with the rim of your shield, dealing 5 damage and leaving the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Skipping Rim
fusions.desc: Hurls your shield into the first enemy it meets, dealing 11 damage and knocking it 2.5 tiles back. It then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Braced Cover
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 30% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Guard Between Swings
fusions.desc: When you strike an enemy, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
